svg.text: 2440 x 1220 | 19.6 finished plywood, HPL both faces | kerf 4 | trim 5 each edge
BEDROOM WORKSHOP | mm | verify stock and purchased hardware before cutting | revision 2026-11-15
3 panels | blank area 0.045 m2 | sheet use 1.5% | 5 guillotine cuts
Orange = banded edge. Dimensions = laminated blank BEFORE edge band. Grey = kerf, trim or offcut.
L1/L2 are the two edges parallel to finished Length; W1/W2 parallel to Width. Orange thickness is symbolic.
Grain: rotation allowed by default for plain laminate. Set AllowRotation = 0 for directional laminate and regenerate.
Follow SawCuts.csv / native SawCuts sheet for the cutting sequence; label each piece immediately.
Trim all four edges first. Origin is the stock lower-left corner; X along 2440, Y along 1220.
Drill cable passages, rout internal grip recesses, and cut scribe strips to fit AFTER the rectangular blanks are cut.
Heuristic nesting of each project separately; sheet count is the achieved layout, not a guaranteed minimum.
